BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Agriculture, Water, Trade & Economic Development.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Requiring certain water banks to replace leased water rights provided for mitigation with water rights that will be permanently available.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring certain water banks to replace leased water rights provided for mitigation with water rights that will be permanently available; and adding a new section to chapter 90.42 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 90.42 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Any county-operated water bank that leases water rights to offer for mitigation must replace the leased water rights with water rights that will be permanently available for mitigation prior to the expiration of the lease.
